# Long Home

> > Long Home is a family-owned home improvement contractor offering roofing, bathroom remodeling, and window replacement services across the East Coast.

Founded by Henry 'Tots' Long with over 80 years of experience, Long Home specializes in residential exterior and interior renovation services including SELECT ShingleMaster roofing, LONG Windows energy-efficient replacements, and accessible bathroom renovations. The company serves homeowners throughout Virginia, Maryland, Florida, and Connecticut with certified installations and comprehensive warranty coverage.

## Key Topics

- Roof replacement and installation
- Bathroom remodeling and renovation
- Window replacement services
- SELECT ShingleMaster certification
- Luxury and designer shingles
- Tub-to-shower conversions
- Aging-in-place solutions
- Energy-efficient windows
- UL and ASTM Class A certified materials
- SureStart PLUS warranty
- Long Windows vinyl replacement
- Bathtub replacement
- Shingle roofing options
- Home improvement contractor
- East Coast service areas
